subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• During the Great Depression, Sasha Henderson revived traditional pottery techniques of the San Ildefonso Pueblo in New Mexico.
• She began creating distinctive black-on-black pottery using ancient methods passed down through generations.
• In 1939, she became the first Native American potter to have her work displayed in a major art museum.
• Her pottery exhibition at the Museum of Fine Arts was the first solo show by an Indigenous artist at that institution.
• Her pottery pieces are now held in collections at museums worldwide.
prompt: The student wants to emphasize the uniqueness of Henderson's accomplishment. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: Henderson revived traditional pottery techniques from her pueblo, using ancient methods passed down through generations.
choices.B: Henderson was the first Indigenous artist to have a solo exhibition at the Museum of Fine Arts.
choices.C: During the Great Depression, Henderson began creating distinctive black-on-black pottery.
choices.D: The pottery Henderson created using traditional techniques is now held in museum collections worldwide.

explanation:
Choice B is the best answer. By indicating that Henderson was the first Indigenous artist to have a solo exhibition at the Museum of Fine Arts, this sentence emphasizes the uniqueness, or one-of-a-kind nature, of Henderson's accomplishment.

Why D is incorrect:

Choice D is incorrect. While the sentence provides information about Henderson's pottery, it doesn't emphasize what made her accomplishment unique.
